details: Bitcoin dropped below $72,000, reaching a 10-week low, while Ethereum also slipped below $2,000. This downturn is largely driven by substantial outflows from US spot Bitcoin ETFs, totaling $1.4 billion last week. Escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, with reports of US-Iran military action and suspended talks, are further fueling risk aversion across the crypto market.
title: Bitcoin Slides Below $72K as ETF Outflows & Middle East Tensions Weigh

details: Michael Saylor's Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) sold 32 Bitcoins for approximately $2.5 million between May 26 and May 31, its first such sale since December 2022. While a minor portion of its holdings, the move created selling pressure and raised questions as the company has been a prominent Bitcoin accumulator. The proceeds are intended to fund preferred stock dividend payments.
title: Michael Saylor's Strategy Sells 32 BTC, First Sale Since 2022

details: Vietnam's Ministry of Finance has proposed amendments to its Law on Support for Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises (SMEs), which would allow digital assets, virtual assets, and intellectual property to be used as collateral for bank loans. This initiative aims to expand credit access for SMEs, which constitute over 98% of Vietnamese businesses but receive only a fraction of total bank credit.
title: Vietnam Eyes Digital Assets and IP as SME Loan Collateral
